config.title: Happy Toes - A Poem
config.topic: A father’s poem written for his daughter Abby during incarceration, which later grew into a published book with literary reinterpretations.
config.description: This episode explores the emotional origin of the poem, the father–daughter connection, the transformation of the poem into a full book, and the deeper themes of legacy, distance, and creativity.
key_points: The emotional origin of the poem during incarceration
The father–daughter bond and why the poem mattered
How the poem expanded into a full book
Literary reinterpretations and what they reveal
Themes of legacy, distance, and connection
